title: npm publish token committed in the client configuration
description: .npmrc declares a registry authentication token written directly into the checked-in client configuration. Anyone with repository read access can publish as the token's owner, and the token keeps working until it is rotated by hand.
remediation: Read the token from the environment (`${NPM_AUTH_TOKEN}`) and keep only a placeholder in the file.
limitation: It matches a registry authentication token written directly into the checked-in client configuration in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
